name: Four Seasons Orlando at Walt Disney World
positioning: Luxury resort on Walt Disney World property
best_for: Couples on an adults' Orlando trip

facts.text: Opened August 2014: 443 keys (375 rooms and 68 suites) in a 17-storey building on 26.5 acres.
Located in the Golden Oak community on Walt Disney World property, at 10100 Dream Tree Blvd., Lake Buena Vista, about three miles from Magic Kingdom.
AAA Five Diamond resort (Central Florida's first, per Visit Orlando).
Other dining: Ravello (modern Italian, with character dining), PB&G (Southern and Florida), Plancha (Cuban American) and the Lobby Bar.
Oasis is an infinity-edge lakeside pool for guests 21 and over; the resort has five pools in total.
Tranquilo Golf Course is a Tom Fazio design (par 71, 6,968 yards) and a certified Audubon sanctuary.

highlights.text: Explorer Island is a heated five-acre water park with a lazy river with rapids and two water slides.
Guests get Early Theme Park Entry (30 minutes early daily) and complimentary luxury motor coach transportation to the Disney parks.
Kids For All Seasons is a complimentary daily camp for ages 4-12 at The Mansion on Explorer Island.
Capa, the Spanish steakhouse with a rooftop terrace for fireworks views, held a Michelin star 2022-2025 and is Michelin Recommended in the 2026 Florida guide.

considerations.text: Magic Kingdom is about three miles away. Guests use the hotel's complimentary motor coach, and Magic Kingdom guests are dropped at the Ticket & Transportation Center for the monorail.
Capa lost its Michelin star in the 2026 Florida guide (now Recommended). Older copy calling it Michelin-starred is out of date.
The Oasis pool is adults 21+ only. Families use Explorer Island and the family pool.
Fireworks are visible from Capa's rooftop terrace.
The kids' club is for ages 4-12.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily (the standard published rate is room only, with breakfast usually extra).
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers are combinable with the exclusive perks.
